referenceFunction.generalComment: The module includes the use of energy and auxiliary materials for the operation of lighting, impeller blower and ventilator. The functional unit is kg DM hay (DM: dry matter).; UUID: fd0ed3a0-b02b-314d-ab4b-93ba1a57ab75
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The inventory takes into account the energy and auxiliary materials like water, lubricating oil and cleaning agents. Also included is the use of the infrastructure. Not taken into account were the direct emission of the animal husbandry, fodder production and produced waste water.

geography.text: The inventory applies for Swiss agricultural buildings only, because of the solid method of construction.

technology.text: The use of energy and auxiliary materials are calculated for the conditions defined in the infrastructure-module with literature data and experts knowledge.

representativeness.productionVolume: Existing dried roughage stores with solar air dry in CH in 1996: 2140 units.
representativeness.samplingProcedure: In the use of energy and auxiliary materials are big differences between the farms. The inventory is based on mean values from CH and WEU.
